title: [RM-905] Deactivate expired strategies safely
author: RobertoFZ
body: Deactivate every expired strategy while isolating failures so a later run can retry any item that did not complete. Linear: https://linear.app/reservamos/issue/RM-905
derived_from: A recent review pattern where status=False is saved before dependent updates and external effects; an exception leaves partial state and the next run filters the item out.
